what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: maximised logLik of the pois_exposure fit
cases.note: Poisson, K = 1, p = 6, n = 150 (sha256 checked); R: value ~ 0 + trait + latent(0 + trait | unit, d = 1, unique = FALSE), family = poisson(), converged with a positive-definite Hessian; same optimum (logLik within 1e-6, asserted in the test). The sign of a one-axis loading is not identified, so loadings are compared through Lambda Lambda'. R: + offset(log(e)) with e = the data column e (varies by cell, 0.5 to 3); Julia: offset = log.(E). The exposure offset moves the logLik by more than 150 against the no-offset fit.
